description: A token's supply: five tiles (ET-31267: circulating of max, market cap -> FDV with its multiple, dilution over the next 12 months as dilution_12m_pct, to_holders dollars a month and how, staked with its exit rule - red only on a published exit within 7 days), the next unlock summed over its recipients, and out_by_month (tokens out at the end of each month). Pass symbol (a Gem Screener coin's ticker, slug or CoinGecko id; a ticker two tokens share answers AMBIGUOUS_TICKER with the options) OR contract + chain (any token; price from DeFiLlama, totalSupply from the chain). A tile is null when its inputs were not read; with no schedule and no emissions published, schedule_published is false and dilution_12m_pct and yearly_pct are null (never 0). The record also carries inputs[] (value, unit, source, as_of), unknown_names[], months[] (in and out by kind, tranches) and refreshed_at. From EventTrader's Supply Analyzer (cymetica.com/supply-analyzer). Every input carries its value, unit, source and date; unknown inputs are named, never zero. A measure of the token's supply, not a forecast of its price. Read-only, no key. Not financial advice.

chain.description: Chain of the contract: ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche (needed with contract)

contract.description: Token contract address (identifies the token exactly)

symbol.description: Ticker, slug or CoinGecko id of a Gem Screener coin
